features: 聊天对象档案：保存不同对象的人设、关系、场景、表达分寸和目标，主应用与键盘共用
导入本机图片表情：预览、改名、删除、收藏、最近使用，并纳入加密备份
账号密码确认注销、云端同步容量查询和版本校验删除；防止注销并发重建及删错已切换空间
长截图在本机先分段再缩放，逐段识别和核对，支持按原顺序合并文字；兼顾小屏和大字号
fixedEdges: rename inactive object preserves active ID and saved preferences
leaving file picker prevents late import; stale refresh cannot overwrite mutations
backup persona conflict remaps only imported object references; newly imported library waits for manual object selection
current password and exact confirmation required for closure; tenant and owner scope preserved; transactions recheck account before creating sync space
cloud deletion requires capability, current revision and locally confirmed space ID; cannot resurrect with an older write; remote success/local cleanup failure clearly separated
late closure response and cleanup cannot clear a newer login; unmounted component cannot notify parent

validation.postgresIsolation: connection-local TEMP tables only; no production user/space mutations
validation.nativeEvidence: real shipping Kotlin objects; PNG pixel alpha/bounds; original long image region positions/overlap; profile roundtrip/autosave; encrypted backup payload integration and restore idempotence
validation.uiEvidence: explicit Android SAF import and long image selection, host rename/favorite to IME preview and object switching; no send

remaining.detail: 当前主动联网语音保持原有能力；这些扩展尚未实现。
